experiments.name: high-unroll fixed-operand chain
experiments.notes: Fixed dividend=max, divisor=2, measured with unroll=100000. chain_latency 2 subtracts the and+or reset chain.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent, and a ladder rather than a set of discrete classes: latency = 7 + floor(bits(|quotient|)/2), because the divider retires two quotient bits per cycle. The minimum is 5 with a zero dividend and a divisor of 2 or more; a divisor of 1 costs one cycle more (6) because the quotient then equals the dividend and is never zero. The maximum is 22 for a 31-bit quotient. The divider works on the magnitudes, so the sign of the operands does not matter, and it skips trailing zero digits, which is why 0x10 / 1 costs 7 cycles instead of 9 and -2^63 / 1 is fast. Measured with the exact chain `div.w $r4, $r4, $r5` and divisor 1, which returns its own value and walks the ladder by changing --init. `mod` shares the divider and measures the same. The cases array holds named sample points on this ladder, not an exhaustive classification.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; addi.d $r20, $r0, 9; addi.d $r21, $r0, 10; addi.d $r23, $r0, 11; addi.d $r24, $r0, 12; addi.d $r25, $r0, 13; addi.d $r26, $r0, 14; addi.d $r27, $r0, 15; addi.d $r28, $r0, 16
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; addi.d $r20, $r0, 9; addi.d $r21, $r0, 10; addi.d $r23, $r0, 11; addi.d $r24, $r0, 12; addi.d $r25, $r0, 13; addi.d $r26, $r0, 14; addi.d $r27, $r0, 15; addi.d $r28, $r0, 16' --asm 'div.w $r12, $r4, $r20; div.w $r13, $r5, $r21; div.w $r14, $r6, $r23; div.w $r15, $r7, $r24; div.w $r16, $r8, $r25; div.w $r17, $r9, $r26; div.w $r18, $r10, $r27; div.w $r19, $r11, $r28'
throughput.notes:
Data-dependent. Min/max measured over a range of divisors with 8 independent lanes.

Min CPI 3.499 at divisor=0x80000000; max CPI 12.005 at divisor=0x2; dividend=0x7fffffff.

notes: Latency: fixed-operand and+or chain with unroll=100000; 2 cycles subtracted for and+or. Throughput: 8 independent lanes with the same dividend/divisor pair. Both latency and throughput are data-dependent.
